SmjCdnEnabled.description: Whether to load MathJax from a CDN instead of the bundled local copy

SmjCdnVersion.description: MathJax version to load from the CDN

SmjExtraDelimitersEnabled.description: Whether to also scan for bare delimiters (e.g. $...$), outside of <math>/<chem>

SmjExtraDelimitersInlineMath.description: Inline math delimiter pairs for extra delimiter scanning, e.g. [['$','$']]

SmjExtraDelimitersDisplayMath.description: Display math delimiter pairs for extra delimiter scanning, e.g. [['$$','$$']]

SmjEnableMenu.description: Whether to enable MathJax context menu

SmjAllowedAttributes.description: Generic HTML attributes to carry over from <math>/<chem> to the output <span>
